Leading with our core values, we help companies across every industry blaze new trails and connect with customers in a whole new way. And, we empower you to be a Trailblazer too, driving your performance and career growth, charting new paths, and improving the state of the world. If you believe in business as the greatest platform for change and in companies doing well and doing good, you've come to the right place.

About the Role

Production leadership required. Builder mindset non-negotiable.

 

Salesforce is hiring a Portfolio Leader to directly manage and grow a team of technical AI specialists deploying Agentforce solutions inside complex customer environments. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can drive engineering excellence while operating at the executive level. This is not a traditional people manager, but a mission-critical multiplier on the agentic frontier. You will lead a blended delivery team made up of two specialist functions: Forward Deployed Engineers (Technical Builders - who design, build, and deploy AI Agents directly in customer environments) and Deployment Strategists (Strategic Builders - customer-facing advisors who shape AI strategy, define use cases, and drive adoption). Together, these teams work alongside customers to co-build and deliver agentic AI solutions on a single large enterprise account or across multiple engagements simultaneously. You'll set the engineering standards, unblock complex customer deployments, and scale the talent that's shipping production AI today. 

The Builder Leadership Experience

Delivery Team Coordination: You own the capacity planning, talent acquisition, and staffing that ensures your cross-functional squads have the horsepower to deploy Agentforce at enterprise scale. 

AI-Augmented Leadership: Your team ships solutions using a best-in-class suite of AI tools (Cursor, Claude, and Salesforce coding products like Vibes). You will foster an inclusive, high-energy, and psychologically safe engineering culture where builders iterate fast and continuously level up.

Direct Product Influence: You stand at the center of the product feedback loop. Partner directly with the Product and Engineering organizations on pilot programs and beta rollouts, turning raw field insights from high-stakes deployments into features on the Agentforce core roadmap.

What You'll Actually Be Building & Execution

Leadership & Team Excellence

Scale Elite Talent: Recruit, mentor, and develop the next wave of Technical and Strategic Builders. Drive technical excellence, structure career growth, and foster an environment where shipping high-quality, production-ready systems is the norm.

Maintain Operational Velocity: Monitor key delivery metrics, coach your teams on optimization, and run hard on complex customer escalations. You ensure your teams move from sketch to deployable in weeks, not months.

Technical Strategy & Authority

Ultimate Technical Authority: Serve as the final technical escalation point for your portfolio. Maintain deep architectural judgment across the Salesforce platform, advanced LLM techniques, data pipelines, and agentic orchestration.

Guide Enterprise Implementations: Unblock complex data readiness, tool integration, and multi-agent orchestration challenges. Step in directly to help your teams assess customer technical readiness, remove deployment barriers, and codify standardized, repeatable delivery methodologies.

Customer & Business Impact

Drive Agentic Adoption: Build and anchor strong executive-level relationships within your customer portfolio, ensuring flawless Agentforce activation, rollout, and sustained production value.

Accelerate Portfolio Performance: Operationally run your account portfolio with engineering rigor - monitoring health, delivery velocity, and core consumption metrics to accelerate progress toward customer business outcomes.

Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner lock-step with Services, Account Success, and Product teams to help enterprises activate and consume Agentforce quickly, moving customers from pilot to production at hyper-speed.

You're Our Builder Lead If…

You Have Proven Leadership: 4+ years of direct people management or high-impact technical leadership steering cross-functional engineering or technical teams. You have a track record of hiring, mentoring, and scaling technical talent.

You Bring Advanced Technical Depth: Deep architectural understanding of AI, LLMs, and the Salesforce ecosystem. You have hands-on experience with enterprise software implementation, data modeling, API integration, and AI deployments.

You Own the Agentforce & Data Cloud Blueprint: You possess direct, hands-on experience architecting or deploying Salesforce Data Cloud and the Agentforce platform. You don't just understand the tech stack - you know how to orchestrate it to unblock enterprise scale and drive immediate production value.

You Lead with an Enterprise Customer Focus: Strong background navigating high-touch customer strategies at a Global level, paired with exceptional executive-level communication and influence skills. You can hold your own in a room with customer CTOs and enterprise architects.

You Have a Ship-It Mindset: Exceptional problem-solving instincts, extreme resourcefulness, and a "get-things-done" demeanor. You thrive at the technical helm where code is being actively shipped, not just talking about it.

Nice-to-Haves

Hands-on experience building multi-agent systems, prompt engineering pipelines, or deterministic AI guardrails.

Familiarity with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery) and enterprise data pipelines.

Relevant Salesforce certifications (Advanced Admin, Service Cloud, Data Cloud, Sales Cloud, or Agentforce Specialist).

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

description:
About Us

Since 1989, SHI International Corp. has helped organizations change the world through technology. We’ve grown every year since, and today we’re proud to be a $16 billion global provider of IT solutions and services.

 

Over 17,000 organizations worldwide rely on SHI’s concierge approach to help them solve what’s next. But the heartbeat of SHI is our employees – all 7,000 of them. If you join our team, you’ll enjoy:

Our commitment to diversity, as the largest minority- and woman-owned enterprise in the U.S.

Continuous professional growth and leadership opportunities.

Health, wellness, and financial benefits to offer peace of mind to you and your family.

World-class facilities and the technology you need to thrive – in our offices or yours. 

Job Summary

We are seeking an Associate Director - Solutions Portfolio Operations to support the evolution of SHI’s portfolio by translating technical capabilities into differentiated, outcome-driven solutions.

Working in close collaboration with Marketing, Sales, Delivery, and other cross-functional teams, this role is responsible for the processes, governance, and operating model SHI uses to bring offerings to market. The Associate Director will oversee solution development, launch, and lifecycle management, helping design customer-centric solutions that align with organizational goals and market demands.

This role will also drive continuous improvement efforts, leveraging new technologies and methodologies to enhance go-to-market effectiveness and enable greater consistency, speed, and quality.

Role Description

Operational Leadership

Lead Solution Marketing portfolio operations, development, and governance.

Translate portfolio strategy into operating plans, resource priorities, decision rights, and measurable outcomes.

Provide leadership visibility into portfolio progress, launches, dependencies, risks, and decisions.

Align Marketing, pillar leaders, technical teams, Services, Sales, Alliances, and Operations around shared portfolio standards and priorities.

Lead adoption of new solution development processes, governance, and tools while balancing enterprise consistency with business needs.

Resolve ownership, priority, and process barriers to keep development and launches moving.

Solution Development Process and Governance

Own and improve SHI’s end-to-end solution development process, from intake and qualification through launch, lifecycle management, and retirement.

Establish consistent requirements for prioritization, approval, documentation, handoffs, and launch readiness.

Partner with technical and business owners to ensure solution inputs are accurate, complete, and market-ready.

Portfolio Operations and Rationalization

Maintain an enterprise-wide view of the solution portfolio across pillars, service lines, partners, and lifecycle stages.

Partner with business and technical leaders to identify gaps, overlap, inconsistent packaging, and opportunities to consolidate or expand offerings.

Organize the portfolio around customer needs and outcomes, including integrated journeys across presales, implementation, optimization, and managed services.

Lead portfolio reviews that inform prioritization, investment, and lifecycle decisions.

Solution Catalog and Content Operations

Govern solution taxonomy, naming, metadata, documentation standards, and catalog readiness.

Ensure approved solution information is consistent across the SHI Solution Catalog, SHI One, marketplaces, co-sell listings, and foundational sales and marketing assets.

Partner with program operations to maintain portfolio accuracy and identify opportunities to automate documentation, publishing, and reporting.

Go-to-Market and Launch Operations

Establish a repeatable launch framework covering positioning, documentation, catalog readiness, sales enablement, communications, partner alignment, and measurement.

Coordinate cross-functional launch plans, owners, dependencies, timing, and success measures.

Ensure effective handoffs from solution development to go-to-market activation and conduct post-launch reviews to improve future execution.

Market, Customer, and Performance Insights

Use customer, market, sales, partner, and performance insights to inform portfolio and solution decisions.

Define and track measures for development cycle time, process adoption, launch readiness, catalog health, seller engagement, solution adoption, and influenced pipeline.

Turn performance findings into recommendations for portfolio, process, and investment improvements.

Behaviors and Competencies

Strategic Thinking: Connect business strategy, customer needs, portfolio decisions, and go-to-market execution.

Operational Leadership: Turn strategy into repeatable processes, clear ownership, and measurable execution.

Portfolio Mindset: Evaluate offerings as an integrated portfolio based on customer value, strategic fit, and business potential.

Business Acumen: Connect portfolio decisions to growth, adoption, customer value, and partner priorities.

Cross-Functional Influence: Align stakeholders and drive decisions across a complex, matrixed organization.

Communication: Simplify complex capabilities, processes, and recommendations for varied audiences.

People Leadership: Build accountable, high-performing teams through clear expectations, coaching, and delegation.

Continuous Improvement: Use data and feedback to improve speed, quality, and scale.

Solution, service, or product development operating models - Advanced

Portfolio strategy, rationalization, governance, and lifecycle management - Advanced

Cross-functional launch, program, and change management - Advanced

Team leadership and senior stakeholder influence - Advanced

Process design, workflow improvement, and governance - Advanced

Executive communication, facilitation, and business writing - Advanced

Portfolio measurement, dashboards, and reporting - Intermediate to Advanced

B2B technology, IT services, or solution-provider knowledge - Intermediate to Advanced

Other Requirements

Completed bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant work experience required.

8–12 years of experience in solution or product marketing, portfolio or product management, or a related field.

4+ years of experience leading people or complex cross-functional programs.

Demonstrated experience building or improving portfolio, solution development, and launch processes in a B2B technology or services environment.

Ability to travel to SHI, Partner, and Customer Events - up to 25%

Benefits may include, but are not limited to, medical, vision, dental, 401K, and flexible spending

description:
Are you an experienced Statistical Programming professional with deep knowledge of clinical drug development? Would you like to use your technical expertise to provide strategic programming leadership and help shape the delivery of clinical development programmes? Join us at AstraZeneca CVRM (Cardiovascular Renal Metabolism) Biometrics to impact a wide range of engaging projects striving to make a difference for millions of patients. Our Biometrics team consists of Statisticians, Programmers, Information and Data Scientists. We drive and contribute to optimized clinical drug development programs and access to information and scientific knowledge management.

We are now offering an exciting opportunity for a dedicated and highly motivated individual to join us as Statistical Programming, Associate Director, providing strategic programming leadership within CVRM Biometrics and collaborating with global product development teams.

This role is primarily focused on strategic and technical leadership, planning and project management rather than hands-on statistical programming. You will draw on your technical programming expertise to provide direction, oversee delivery and support high-quality decision-making.

This role will be placed at AstraZeneca’s dynamic R&D strategic site in Gothenburg (Sweden), where you will work in an international environment at the forefront of clinical development.

Accountabilities:

As a Statistical Programming, Associate Director, you are accountable for quality, timely and efficient delivery of project programming work and information management. This position requires profound programming experience and excellent industry knowledge to provide strategic and technical leadership across programming activities, including planning and project management. This is a strategic leadership role with project and technical focus where you will provide subject matter expertise within the statistical programming discipline. You will oversee the delivery of data according to industry standards, and high-quality statistical analyses and reporting deliverables, as well as planning and execution of submission strategies. You will act as a specialist within cross-functional teams to drive continuous improvement, innovation, and automation solutions.

Essential Skills/Experience:

Degree in Mathematics (e.g., Applied Math, Engineering, etc.), Statistics, Computer Science, Life Science, or equivalent experience

Advanced knowledge of the clinical development process and industry standards

Demonstrated programming leadership capability, with the ability to provide strategic and technical direction, develop teams and individuals, and lead them towards a common goal without formal line management responsibility

Demonstrated influencing, planning and organizational skills

Ability to provide input to functional strategies

Expertise in risk management in complex or novel situations

Strong technical experience in SAS and CDISC standards, together with current knowledge and awareness of regulatory requirements relevant to Statistical Programming

 

Desirable Skills/Experience:

Broad experience, ideally across multiple therapeutic areas and/or beyond Statistical Programming

Experience in regulatory submissions and regulatory interactions

Demonstrated experience in designing and implementing business processes

Willingness and ability to travel

At AstraZeneca, we believe in the potential of our people, and you’ll develop beyond what you thought possible. We make the most of your skills and passion by actively supporting you to see what you can achieve no matter where you start with us. In this role, you’ll play a pivotal role in channeling our scientific capabilities to make a positive impact on changing patients’ lives and join us on an exciting journey to pioneer the future of healthcare.

This role is an office-based role with some degree of flexibility. Our vibrant office sites provide a diverse and collaborative work environment, where interactions lead to ideas and innovations, giving you and others the perfect opportunity to learn, grow and develop careers.

Are you ready to bring new ideas and fresh thinking to the table? Brilliant! We have a seat available, and we hope it’s yours. Apply today!

Welcome with your application no later than November 18th, 2026.

title: Director EUIT, Finance Product Impact, Value and Portfolio
description:
The Director, Finance Product Impact, Value and Portfolio is accountable for proving and growing the value delivered by all 17 Finance IT products across Core Finance and Finance Planning and Analytics. This role owns product health and maturity measurement, value-realisation and benefits tracking against the run-cost bridge, the product portfolio and demand pipeline, product craft standards, and the single in-house performance scorecard for AI agents and partner delivery pods. Reporting to the Executive Director, Finance IT, and leading a team of four, the Director gives the leadership team the evidence needed to decide where to invest, sustain, consolidate or retire, and to confirm that the product-and-platform operating model is delivering outcomes, not just activity. Central to the role is making the true value of IT visible and credible to the business; recognising IT not merely as a cost to be contained but as a driver of capacity, speed, quality, control and competitive advantage for the Core Functions and translating that value into hard outcomes, including a measurable productivity saving of at least 10% for each function served. The Director partners closely with the two Product Line Leads, the Senior Director Product Design and Solutions, the Director Transformation and Product Experience, senior Finance business leaders, strategic partners, Procurement, and Central Technology Risk and Data Governance to maximise value and innovation in a product-centric organisation. 

  

Key Responsibilities  

Value Realisation and Benefits Tracking: Define and run the value-measurement discipline across all 17 products, tracking benefits against the run-cost bridge ($20.0M today to the $15.0M plan of record and the $13.5M stretch aim). Report the value of agents that run IT itself and of agents that serve the business separately, never netted. Own the target of delivering a 10% productivity saving for each Core Function releasing time, effort and spend to be reinvested in higher-value work and evidence it product by product alongside the run-cost bridge, so the function sees a clear, auditable return on its IT investment.  

• Product Health and Maturity: Maintain one consistent health and maturity view of every product, covering adoption, quality, user experience, run cost and control health. Trigger intervention with the Product Line Leads where a product falls below threshold, and keep the evidence base current for leadership and gate reviews.  

• Portfolio and Demand Management: Own the portfolio and demand pipeline and keep prioritisation honest. Recommend which products to invest in, sustain, consolidate or retire, and support the phased launch of the 17 products.  

• Agent and Pod Performance Scorecard: Own the single scorecard for AI agents and partner delivery pods, covering accuracy, deflection, Service-Level Agreement and Experience-Level Agreement performance, and cost. Provide the evidence for the agent governance plane and for the two-of-four pause criterion at each phase gate.  

• Product Craft and Standards: Raise product-management craft across Product Owners and Product Analysts through standards, playbooks, coaching and a graduate pipeline, so that every product team operates to a consistent, defensible bar.  

• Team Leadership: Lead and develop a high-performing team of four, comprising two Value Measurement Leads and two Product Craft and Agent Scorecard specialists. Foster a culture of evidence, accountability and continuous improvement, and own talent development and succession planning for key roles.  

• Stakeholder and Partner Management: Manage and influence the Executive Director, Product Line Leads and senior Finance business leaders on value and portfolio decisions. Hold the embedded Outsourcing partner to account on outcome measures, working with EUIT Operational Excellence on supplier governance and with Procurement on commercial terms such as gain-share and service credits.  

• Governance, Risk and Compliance: Ensure value, benefits and scorecard reporting is auditable and evidence-based. Work with Central Technology Risk and Data Governance on AI guardrails, and ensure no agent is treated as a control until the first clean financial year-end and per-agent auditor sign-off are in place. 

• AI Adoption and Change Management: Be the thought leader for measuring the impact of AI digital workers. Feed adoption and performance evidence to the Director Transformation and Product Experience and the Senior Director Product Design and Solutions so that digital-worker leverage is directed where it creates most value. 

• Budget Management: Develop, deliver and monitor the budget, including capital, for the Product Impact, Value and Portfolio area, and track the savings run-rate against plan, flagging early where it falls below 85% of plan.  

Key Qualifications, Skills and Experience  

Key Qualifications:  

• Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field of study – Finance, Business, Engineering, Computer Science or Information Technology. Masters degree desirable.  

• Significant experience in a client-facing IT or product role, including strategic planning, business plan and case development, and client management.  

• Significant experience in value realisation and benefits tracking, including business models, operating models, financial models, cost-benefit analysis, budgeting and risk management.  

• Significant experience in product-centric operating models, including product portfolio and demand management, product health and maturity measurement, and product-management craft.  

• Significant experience working with diverse business ecosystems, Cloud and software-as-a-service models, and business applications. More specifically: SAP S/4HANA, BlackLine, Anaplan, Snowflake, Coupa, Concur and AWS Bedrock plus AI foundation models, large language models and measuring the performance of AI agents.  

• Significant experience in one or more Finance areas with a comprehensive understanding of business processes and drivers for success, such as record to report, purchase to pay, order to cash, and planning and forecasting.  

• Experience working with regulatory and control aspects of IT solutions in Finance, including Sarbanes-Oxley attestation and audit-ready evidence.  

• Experience having led large-scale change initiatives from planning to implementation.  

• Experience managing teams with direct and indirect reports, including work delivered through outsourced managed-service partners.  

• Experience managing outcome-based managed-service contracts, including Service-Level Agreements, Experience-Level Agreements, service credits and gain-share mechanisms.  

• Experience in co-working with cross-functional global leadership and other senior stakeholders preferred.  

• Substantial experience managing in a global matrix organisation with geographically dispersed teams.  

• Substantial experience communicating with and influencing diverse internal and external stakeholders, including supplier and vendor networks, across areas and geographies to drive value and portfolio outcomes.  

• Substantial experience anticipating, assessing and managing programme and portfolio risks.  

• Certification in product management, portfolio management or business analysis preferred.  

  

Skills & Technical Proficiency:  

• Critical/ Strategic Thinking: Influences the broader business strategy with data and insights and anticipates futuristic changes.  

• Results & Execution Focus: Sets ambitious yet realistic value targets, measures them rigorously and holds product teams and partners to outcomes.  

• Business & Sustainability: Leverages a strong understanding of the organisational structure and business financials to make strategic recommendations and advocate for sustainable business strategies.  

• Adaptability & Change Orientation: Champions bold moves and systemic changes and models resilience when faced with unexpected changes.  

• Communication, Collaboration & Influence: Is an inspiring communicator, builds strong partnerships, and bridges silos to achieve broader organisational goals.  

• Talent Development: Champions a culture based on feedforward, coaching, and stretch development and ensures a level playing field for diverse talent.  

• Business & Customer Centricity: Leverages a strong understanding of Finance functional domains, customer processes and the related IT landscape to judge where product investment creates most value.  

• Value & Insight Storytelling: Turns product, cost and performance data into clear, decision-ready evidence for the Executive Director and senior Finance leaders, and is candid when the evidence is unwelcome.  

• Product Craft & Portfolio Judgement: Applies product-management standards and portfolio thinking to prioritise, sequence and retire products, balancing value, risk and capacity.  

• AI Performance Measurement: Designs and runs measures for AI agents and partner delivery pods, and drives a culture of proactive change, skill building and application around emerging technologies and ways of working. 

Next Steps? 

Are you ready to step up and take ownership of your work, solutions for the business and your personal career development? Apply now and join us in our mission to bring life-changing medicines to people! 

Where can I find out more?

Follow AstraZeneca on Facebook https://www.facebook.com/astrazenecacareers/ 

Follow AstraZeneca on Instagram https://www.instagram.com/astrazeneca_careers/?hl=en 

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That’s why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we’re not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.

title: Art Director, Brand & Marketing Design
description:
Art Director, Brand & Marketing Design

About the Role

Finom is building a brand that European entrepreneurs recognise and trust, and right now the visual side of that brand needs an owner.

We are looking for an Art Director to lead our Marketing Design team and take ownership of Finom's visual identity end to end. Not marketing design in isolation: the brand system itself, the guidelines behind it, and how consistently it shows up everywhere Finom appears.

You are joining at a genuine inflection point. Finom is growing fast, helping entrepreneurs around Europe take their businesses to the next level. We have over 200k users with ambition for millions more. Meanwhile, our customers rate us 4.8 on Trustpilot, the only business banking app above 4.7.

Our ambition brings with it a unique set of challenges. Your job will be twofold: raise the creative bar, and build the system that lets a team deliver at volume without the quality dropping.

Your first months will be as much about diagnosis as creation: auditing the existing identity, understanding where the current team and workflows are working or falling short, and putting the foundations in place for what comes next. From there, you'll help determine and lead the next evolution of Finom's visual identity.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will direct and mentor, and you will also design, setting the visual benchmark yourself, not just reviewing other people's work against it. You will work in close partnership with our VP of Product Design, so that the brand reads as one across marketing, product, and the entire brand experience.

Finom is building an AI-native production pipeline, and we want a creative leader who is already fluent in it. Not someone curious about AI, someone who has shipped with it and can design the workflows, quality gates and brand guardrails that make AI output genuinely good rather than merely fast.

What You Will Be Doing

•  Own Finom's visual identity (the brand system, guidelines, design systems and documentation) and drive consistent adoption across every team and touchpoint, including teams that produce assets outside your own

•  Set and hold the creative bar. Shape visual direction across channels and make consistency and quality non-negotiable

•  Lead and develop the existing Marketing Design team, assess its capabilities and future shape, and determine where additional permanent, freelance or AI-enabled capacity is needed

•  Define the design requirements for intake, briefing, prioritisation, SLAs and review, working with Brand Operations and Marketing Operations to turn them into scalable processes

•  Design and direct high-quality visual and motion assets that bring the brand to life, personally setting the benchmark for the wider team

•  Build the AI-native production pipeline: define where AI accelerates the work, where it doesn't, and what quality and brand-integrity gates it has to pass. Create the templates, systems and tools that let both designers and AI workflows execute independently

•  Provide creative direction at the front of significant projects (the creative kickoff, the concept, the narrative) rather than reviewing work once it's already been produced

•  Direct the creation of mood boards, design references, scamps, storyboards and animatics to communicate creative intent

•  Partner with Marketing, Product, copywriters and strategists to develop campaigns across digital-first channels (social, web, video), with the ability to stretch into ATL where the moment calls for it

•  Own projects from concept through delivery, and run multiple parallel workstreams without letting standards slip

•  Build and present creative work to senior stakeholders, articulating rationale clearly enough to guide decisions

title: Senior Accessibility Program Manager
description:
About GitHub

GitHub is the world’s leading platform for agentic software development — powered by Copilot to build, scale, and deliver secure software. Over 180 million developers, including more than 90% of the Fortune 100 companies, use GitHub to collaborate, and more than 77,000 organisations have adopted GitHub Copilot.

Locations

In this role you can work from Remote, United States

Overview

At GitHub, our mission is to accelerate human progress through developer collaboration. We believe people with disabilities should benefit from that progress and directly contribute to the creation of it. 

 

We are seeking a forward-thinking, determined and innovative individual, who is passionate about the intersection of accessibility and technology, to help implement our accessibility strategy, which can be found at accessibility.github.com. This role will report directly to the Head of Accessibility and will be empowered to drive change internally and externally. 

 

 The successful candidate will:

  • Have a deep understanding of accessibility, assistive technologies, and the ways that people with disabilities interact with technology.
  • Have technical expertise that is grounded in professional experience as a software developer or designer.
  • Have hands-on experience using AI and automation to improve accessibility at scale.
  • Have professional experience managing accessibility initiatives within a large matrixed organization.
  • Have a proven track record of delivering results that empower people with disabilities to use technology. 

Responsibilities

 The goals of the GitHub accessibility program are to: 

  • Empower GitHub employees to do the best work of their lives by creating an accessible work environment with internal guides and support for procurement processes.

  • Empower developers with disabilities to build on GitHub by including their input throughout the development process, cultivating a culture of accessibility within GitHub, and driving accountability at scale.

  • Empower our customers to meet their accessibility goals when building on GitHub by aggressively dogfooding the latest GitHub platform and AI features to run our internal accessibility program, Open-sourcing our internal tools when appropriate, and sharing best practices externally.

  • Help improve the accessibility of open source by empowering people with disabilities to contribute, improving the availability and adoption of open-source Assistive Technologies, and improving the accessibility of mainstream open-source projects. 

The Senior Accessibility Program Manager may contribute to all of those program goals over time. That said, their initial focus will include, but is not limited to:

  • Manage listening systems including inclusive user research and feedback processes.
  • Build an accessibility community of practice within our Enterprise customer community.
  • Grow the capabilities of the open-source GitHub accessibility scanner and accelerate adoption by customers and open-source communities. 

Qualifications

Required Qualifications :

  • 7+ years experience in Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR), sustainability, accessibility engineering and design, or related area 

    • OR Bachelor's Degree in Business, Sustainability, Computer Science, Communications/Marketing, or related field AND 5+ years experience in Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR), sustainability, accessibility engineering and design, or related area 

    • OR Master's Degree in Business, Sustainability, Computer Science, Communications/Marketing, or related field AND 3+ years experience in Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR), sustainability, accessibility engineering and design, or related area

    • OR Doctorate in Business, Sustainability, Computer Science, Communications/Marketing, or related field AND 1+ year(s) experience in Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR), sustainability, accessibility engineering and design, or related area

    • OR equivalent experience

  • 3+ years of relevant experience driving programs or initiatives across organizational boundaries in a large organization.
  • 3+ years of experience evaluating the conformance of web content against the Web Content Accessibility guidelines.
  • 1+ years of hands-on experience using AI and automation to improve accessibility at scale. 

 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience developing accessible web-based user interfaces using JavaScript and modern web technologies.
  • Experience collecting and interpreting data for performance metrics and compliance.
  • Understanding of product road mapping and experience working with product and engineering teams to embed new features into roadmap plans. 

We encourage people with lived experience to apply. 


Compensation Range

The base salary range for this job is USD $103,200.00 - USD $273,700.00 /Yr.

These pay ranges are intended to cover roles based across the United States. An individual's base pay depends on various factors including geographical location and review of experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant. At GitHub certain roles are eligible for benefits and additional rewards, including annual bonus and stock. These rewards are allocated based on individual impact in role. In addition, certain roles also have the opportunity to earn sales incentives based on revenue or utilization, depending on the terms of the plan and the employee's role.

This position will be open for a minimum of 3 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

GitHub is the world’s leading AI-powered developer platform with 150 million developers and counting. We’re also home to the biggest open-source community on earth (and 99% of the world’s software has open-source code in its DNA). Many of the apps and programs you use every day are built on GitHub.
Our teams are dreamers, doers, and pioneers, leading the way in AI, driving humanitarian efforts around the globe, and even sending open source to Mars (and beyond!). description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

 
ABOUT THE JOB
 
The Technical Program Manager, Mathematical Software and Algorithms is responsible for overseeing the development, execution, and delivery of the Battlespace Awareness software for critical programs - ensuring it meets all technical, functional, and business requirements. Battlespace Awareness software services comprise advanced algorithms for sense-making and decision-making at tactical timelines.  This role requires an individual with a strong technical background in software development, particularly in the domain of optimization and estimation, and experience managing complex projects with multiple sub-teams and many stakeholders. The Sr Technical Program Manager will be the linchpin in ensuring that the software is developed in line with the objectives defined and is released according to the planned schedule.
 
WHAT YOU'LL DO
  • Project Leadership and Strategy:
    • Develop and maintain a detailed project and execution plan - including feature development, testing and validation, deployment, and monitoring. 
    • Establish clear objectives and deliverables for the software that align with program needs.
  • Technical Expertise:
    • Maintain a deep understanding of underlying algorithms and software interfaces for battle management, threat prediction, tracking, and classification to ensure that the relevant services integrate effectively with the larger C2 system.
    • Stay updated on the latest techniques to work with subject matter experts in incorporating relevant innovations into the project plan.
  • Documentation and Process Improvement:
    • Ensure comprehensive documentation is maintained for the project, including technical specifications, user manuals, and project reports.
    • Continuously evaluate and improve project management processes to increase efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Release Management:
    • Oversee the planning and execution of the software release process, ensuring that deployment is carried out smoothly and efficiently.
    • Ensure that all software releases meet the defined quality standards before deployment.
  • Stakeholder Communication:
    • Serve as the primary point of contact for all project-related communications, internally across teams and externally with stakeholders.
    • Regularly update stakeholders on project status, risks, and milestones through reports and presentations.
  • Resource Allocation:
    • Assess and allocate necessary resources, including personnel, software, and hardware, to ensure the project is adequately supported.
    • Monitor resource utilization and make adjustments as needed to avoid bottlenecks or resource constraints.
  • Risk Management:
    • Identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies with the subject matter experts to minimize impact on the project timeline and deliverables.
    • Regularly review and update the risk management plan to reflect changes in the project landscape.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration:
    • Work with other divisions and departments to ensure software supports the program priorities and meets all integration requirements.
    • Facilitate effective communication and collaboration between the Battlespace Awareness business line and other stakeholders to promote a unified approach to program execution.
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Extensive project management experience, preferably in software development.
  • Demonstrable understanding of optimization, applied probability, and AI/ML technology.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.
  • Experience with tools like JIRA, Confluence, and GitHub
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to manage high-pressure situations and tight deadlines.
  • Must be able to obtain and hold a U.S. security clearance.

PREFERRED QAULIFICATIONS:

  • Familiarity and experience working with materiel leadership or mission partners within Army Air & Missile Defense, USMC Ground Based Air Defense, SOCOM, DHS CBP, or allied defense organizations and working knowledge of the counter-UAS and air surveillance competitive landscape.
  • Experience working on or alongside a team developing mathematical software, such as optimization solvers, estimation engines, simulation frameworks, or applied probability models.

If you do provide academic transcripts, feel free to redact non-technical information (e.g., student ID, dates, non-technical coursework, etc.). Unofficial transcripts obtained online acceptable for this assessment.

description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Staff Portfolio Operations Manager based in Canada.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Staff Portfolio Operations Manager to drive strategic planning, portfolio performance, and operational excellence across multiple product and technology divisions. In this role, you will initially lead Product Operations for the Hospitality business, helping senior leaders improve roadmap execution, resource allocation, and cross-functional collaboration. After an initial six-month assignment, you will transition into a permanent Business Operations position supporting Hospitality, Retail, and Financial Services portfolios. You will leverage financial insights, performance analytics, and business intelligence to guide investment decisions and identify opportunities for growth and efficiency. Working closely with senior leadership, Finance, Product, and Technology teams, you will influence strategic priorities and drive organizational improvements. This is a senior individual contributor opportunity offering significant autonomy, visibility, and the ability to shape business outcomes across a complex international technology environment.

Accountabilities:

Lead Hospitality Product Operations: Take ownership of Product Operations for the Hospitality division during the initial six-month assignment, establishing effective planning, governance, and delivery practices.

Roadmap Planning and Execution: Partner with Product and Technology leaders to develop and execute product roadmaps, manage competing priorities, coordinate dependencies, and proactively address delivery risks.

Operational Performance: Establish structured planning, reporting, and review cadences that provide leadership with clear visibility into progress, emerging challenges, and decisions requiring attention.

Process Optimization: Identify opportunities to improve operational workflows, communication, and collaboration across teams, reducing organizational silos and strengthening execution.

Portfolio Performance Management: Lead portfolio reviews across Hospitality, Retail, and Financial Services, monitoring strategic priorities, investments, delivery progress, and business outcomes.

Data-Driven Decision Making: Develop dashboards, reporting frameworks, and analytical tools to evaluate investment performance, identify performance gaps, and highlight opportunities for improvement.

Investment and Resource Optimization: Analyze business results and underlying performance drivers, recommending changes to priorities, resource allocation, and investments based on expected business value.

Cross-Portfolio Planning: Maintain visibility across product roadmaps, identifying shared dependencies, competing demands, operational risks, and opportunities for collaboration between business divisions.

Strategic Stakeholder Alignment: Work closely with senior leaders, Finance, Product Operations, and Technology teams to challenge assumptions, facilitate strategic discussions, and drive informed decisions.

Leadership Reporting: Prepare clear, actionable recommendations connecting portfolio performance and investment priorities to broader business objectives, ensuring decisions and follow-up actions are tracked through completion.

Go-to-Market Alignment: Establish consistent go-to-market handoff processes across business divisions while accommodating the specific operational needs of each portfolio.

Product and GTM Collaboration: Strengthen communication between Product and Go-to-Market teams throughout the product lifecycle, ensuring upcoming launches, feature releases, and roadmap changes are effectively communicated.

Customer and Market Insights: Develop feedback loops that bring customer needs, market intelligence, and commercial learnings back to Product teams to support roadmap decisions and prioritization.

Continuous Improvement Initiatives: Lead special projects and operational transformation initiatives that improve governance, organizational effectiveness, and overall portfolio performance.

Requirements:

Significant professional experience in SaaS product development, Product Operations, Business Operations, or a related field, with a strong understanding of product development lifecycles, roadmap planning, and execution.

Demonstrated experience managing complex programs or portfolios across multiple teams, including prioritization, resource allocation, cross-functional dependencies, risk management, and business performance.

Strong analytical and financial expertise, with practical experience developing portfolio reports, dashboards, financial models, and investment tracking frameworks.

Proven ability to interpret complex business data and translate performance insights into actionable recommendations that support strategic planning, investment decisions, and operational improvements.

Experience working with and influencing senior executives and cross-functional stakeholders, building alignment, challenging assumptions, and driving decisions without relying on formal authority.

Excellent business judgment and problem-solving abilities, with the confidence to independently identify opportunities, anticipate challenges, and lead initiatives in ambiguous environments.

Experience designing and improving operational processes, governance structures, and ways of working within complex technology or product organizations.

Strong understanding of strategic planning and the ability to balance long-term business objectives with practical operational execution.

Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to simplify complex information and adapt messaging to different audiences.

Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building capabilities, with experience collaborating across Product, Technology, Finance, and commercial functions.

A collaborative and empathetic leadership style, with the ability to understand different perspectives, navigate competing priorities, and develop solutions that deliver meaningful business outcomes.

High levels of autonomy, initiative, organization, and accountability, combined with the ability to manage several strategic priorities simultaneously.

Flexibility to accommodate Eastern Time-based collaboration and business requirements. Candidates located outside the Eastern Time Zone must be willing to adjust their working hours when necessary.

Benefits:

Competitive compensation: Base salary ranging from CAD 170,000 to CAD 200,000, with additional variable compensation opportunities of approximately 50%–60%.

Competitive total compensation: Expected total compensation ranging from CAD 190,000 to CAD 235,000 for eligible Ontario-based candidates, depending on experience, qualifications, and other relevant factors.

Equity opportunities: Access to equity options, providing an opportunity to participate in the organization's long-term growth.

Remote work flexibility: Flexible remote working arrangements designed to support productivity and work-life balance.

Flexible paid time off: Generous paid time-off policies that encourage employees to maintain a healthy balance between professional and personal commitments.

Comprehensive healthcare: Medical, dental, life, and disability insurance coverage.

Retirement benefits: Employer contributions and matching through a registered retirement savings plan (RRSP).

Wellness support: Health and wellness credits to support physical and mental well-being.

Enhanced parental leave: Additional paid parental leave benefits to support employees and their growing families.

Professional development: Training opportunities, continuous learning resources, and career development support.

Career mobility: Opportunities for professional advancement and international career growth.

Technology allowance: Computer purchase program to help employees access the equipment they need.

Community engagement: Paid time to volunteer and contribute to meaningful community initiatives.

Employee networks: Access to employee-led interest groups, social committees, sponsored sports teams, and professional communities.

Inclusive culture: A diverse and collaborative working environment where employees are encouraged to share ideas, contribute to strategic decisions, and develop their potential.

Career-defining opportunities: Work on high-impact strategic initiatives within a growing international technology organization.

The Role

We are looking for a Chief of Staff to help drive Doit's AI Neobank expansion across products, markets and teams. This is a senior execution role for someone who can align leadership, drive operating cadence, solve cross-functional problems and turn strategy into measurable progress.

  • Makes the company move faster and with more clarity. 

Job ID: 10586385 | Amazon.com Services LLC

Apply now

Description

The Energy Analytics, Technical Program Manager (TPM) will scale power monitoring, insight generation, and energy and carbon reduction initiatives across Amazon's North America fulfillment operations. In this hands-on technical role, you will deploy and generate analysis from power metering infrastructure and implement load flexibility and energy optimization roadmaps that deliver measurable cost savings and carbon reductions. This work directly supports Amazon's demand-side power requirements and Climate Pledge commitments.

You will operate as an individual contributor, owning the delivery of defined and ambiguous work-streams while partnering with engineering, controls, data, operations and deployment teams to implement changes. You will influence cross-functional partners without authority, primarily at the team and management level, using data to drive decisions. You will integrate and analyze power metering information, providing load forecasts and generating cost and energy savings opportunities. Utility rate structures, time of day, demand ratchets and power factor penalties will influence your strategies. Technical assets influenced can include material handling, robotics, powered industrial trucks, lighting, heating ventilation and air conditioning, plug loads, electrical metering and more. Developed projects will be scaled across hundreds of facilities across the network, producing energy, cost and carbon benefit.

Key job responsibilities

● Build and execute technical solutions for energy and carbon reduction from pilot, data collection, through scaled implementation and measurement & verification (M&V) of results.  Energy and load optimization via control systems is a technical requirement: energy-conservation/standby modes, variable speed applications, and equipment scheduling.

● Drive continuous monitoring and energy efficiency improvements with Amazon's energy consuming assets.  Integrate power metering into our data sets, and develop analytics to identify opportunities, assess trending consumption changes, and measure benefits of conservation efforts.

● Prepare written analysis of feasibility studies and recommendations for various energy monitoring and power flexibility strategies.  Own metering data quality programs, check readings for completeness, outliers, and flag actionable improvements, and reconcile against known loads to ensure trusted insight generation.

● Develop metrics, baselines, and roadmaps that translate technical work into quantified outcomes (energy savings, cost savings or utility tariff arbitrage, load forecast, reliability, carbon reduction).

● Define and own technical approach and cross-system architecture for data configuration, standards and mechanisms for scalability and enforcement of key energy savings mechanisms. Decide how to build and prove new approaches managing tradeoffs for necessary business needs, rather than executing a defined scope.

● Manage projects against plans and objectives to ensure commitments are met, delivering against our power and Climate Pledge goals.

● Deep diving (troubleshooting) and unblocking issues that are prohibiting teams from pursuing energy reduction initiatives.

● Work with critical stakeholders on developing mechanisms for design standard integration for launching facilities that incorporate energy optimization procedures from Day 1.

● Analyze and communicate the financial impact of projects and initiatives (payback, return on investment, net present value)

● Serve as a technical reviewer for peers and partner engineers — reviewing control logic, metering architecture, and design-standard changes, and improving them on technical merit

● Quantify and own value add of energy savings mechanisms and how they reduce equipment runtime and increases reliability and lifespan.

● Calculate and report energy, water and carbon savings using International Performance Measurement and Verification Protocol methodologies.

● Manage multiple, complex projects simultaneously.

● Produce clear documentation, playbooks, and reporting that make work-streams repeatable.

A day in the life

You might spend the morning querying newly integrated power-metering data and validating it against the distribution-panel hierarchy — resolving a data-quality gap — then analyzing load profiles and build an energy-savings or peak-shaving model that quantifies the opportunity by equipment class. You then define network rollout suitability and prioritize these opportunities across sites. In the afternoon you develop control logic changes to implement an efficiency opportunity, propose updates to a design standard, or define a measurement method for implemented energy and cost savings to your stakeholders. You balance trade-offs between energy savings, technical complexity, equipment reliability, and cost — bringing well-reasoned recommendations and escalating the most ambiguous decisions for alignment.

About the team

The Global Energy, Sustainability and Automation (GESA) Energy team is dedicated to delivering energy efficiency, cost savings, and demand flexibility within Amazon's fulfillment network. We partner closely with design, controls, data, procurement, operations, field engineering, and deployment teams — as well as external vendors — to ensure our energy consumption is monitored and optimized. Our focus in the coming years is scaling our energy monitoring and analytics programs, expanding behavioral and retrofit programs, expanding load flexibility for power resilience and cost arbitrage benefit, and enhancing asset reliability and lifespan through efficient operation. If you are energized by large-scale technical challenges and want to make a tangible impact on energy use, this is the team for you.

Basic Qualifications

- 5+ years of technical product or program management experience

- Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science or equivalent

- Experience in SQL Server/MySQL, or experience in Redshift and experience in any Bigdata architecture

- Experience working with existing and emerging technologies related to building energy (i.e. power metering, conveyance, robotics, controls, HVAC, charging infrastructure)

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience managing cross-functional programs and release schedules

- Familiarity with automation engineering and controls engineering concepts.

- Industry certifications: Certified Energy Manager, Certified Measurement & Verification Professional, Professional Engineer.

Global Energy partners closely with regional data center planning and delivery, global sustainability, and broader Amazon business units on energy procurement and infrastructure needs.

About the Role

As a Senior Technical Program Manager on the PGS leadership team, you will report directly to the Head of Power Generation Solutions and serve as a strategic partner to PGS and Global Energy leadership. This is a dual-scope role: you will own technical program management for one of PGS's power programs, while also driving cross-cutting strategy, controllership, and operational mechanisms for PGS and the broader Global Energy organization.

You will work at the intersection of technical execution and business strategy, partnering with PGS engineering leads, Global Energy Principals, Energy Portfolio Operations, Finance, and senior AWS leadership to ensure our programs are on track, our organization is scaled appropriately, and our strategy is clear and actionable. You'll engage external partners, facilitate senior executive interactions, and serve as a trusted voice for PGS in cross-organizational forums.

This role is right for someone who thrives in ambiguity, thinks big, and can operate with equal fluency in a technical design review and a VP-level strategy session.

About You

You have a track record of delivering complex, ambiguous programs at scale — and doing it with the business acumen and executive presence to bring senior leaders along. You are data-driven but not data-bound; you know when to go deep and when to synthesize. You write clearly, speak directly, and earn trust quickly across organizational boundaries.

You are energized by consequential work. AWS's power strategy is shaping how the world's infrastructure gets built — and this role sits at the center of it.

Basic Qualifications

Experience in technical program management, strategy, or related fields in a large-scale infrastructure, energy, or technology organization

Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder programs with senior leadership visibility

Strong analytical skills with demonstrated ability to translate data into strategic recommendations

Excellent written and verbal communication skills; experience preparing materials for VP-level audiences

Key job responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Own technical program management for part of the AWS power program, including pipeline management, milestone tracking, senior leader engagement, and vendor coordination.

Partner with the Head of PGS to develop and maintain a multi-year strategic roadmap for Global Energy, translating long-term priorities into annual execution plans with clear owners and accountability mechanisms.

Lead Global Energy controllership mechanisms, including headcount and resource planning, hiring performance tracking, and operating cadence — ensuring leadership has timely, accurate visibility into organizational health and delivery status.

Develop and manage reporting for senior leadership on program status, strategic initiatives, and organizational metrics; synthesize complex inputs into clear, decision-ready narratives.

Build and maintain trusted relationships with Finance, Talent Acquisition, Human Resources, and partner delivery organizations to ensure Global Energy's full scope of needs is represented in cross-organizational planning.

Drive continuous improvement in Global Energy's operating mechanisms — identifying gaps, proposing solutions, and leading implementation across teams.

Represent PGS and Global Energy in senior forums, including facilitating off-sites, leadership reviews, and partner engagements inside and outside AWS.

Champion a high-performance team culture: model strong judgment, clear communication, and a bias for action.

About the team

The Power Generation Solutions team creates and delivers product and engineering solutions in for power and energy to help advance AWS’ mission to deliver world-leading cloud services. Our solutions are guided by four main principles; unlocking capacity growth, maintaining high infrastructure uptime, minimizing infrastructure costs, and advancing our net-zero carbon Climate Pledge. To deliver these solutions, our team provides technical input to realize a shared vision and strategy with partner teams and provides engineering support across the project or product lifecycle to deliver the solution. We also provide grid analytics and manage and develop models for determining the total energy and water use within our fleet of data centers and work with partners on improving overall performance. 

Basic Qualifications

- 5+ years of program management or technical project management experience

- Experience working in a program management capacity and/or leading large-scale complex projects

- Experience providing and effectively communicating strategic and tactical recommendations based on data

- Experience in verbal and written communication for executive level leaders

- 7+ years of experience in technical program management, strategy, or related fields in a large-scale infrastructure, energy, or technology organization

Preferred Qualifications

- MBA, or Advanced degree

- Experience in energy, power generation, or data center infrastructure

- Familiarity with nuclear energy development, permitting, or procurement processes

- Experience in organizational planning, headcount modeling, or operational controllership

Description

Application deadline: Nov 16, 2026

Today, Amazon Web Services provides a highly reliable, scalable, low cost infrastructure platform in the cloud that powers hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries around the world. The AWS Cloud infrastructure is built around Regions and Availability Zones. AWS Regions provide multiple, physically separated and isolated Availability Zones connected with low latency, high throughput, and highly redundant networking. These Availability Zones give AWS customers an easier and more effective way to design and operate applications and databases, and they make those systems more highly available, fault tolerant, and scalable than traditional single data center or multi data center infrastructures. Would you like to join the team that plans and delivers the network builds behind that low latency, high throughput, and highly redundant network?

Global Connectivity Infrastructure Development (GCID) runs a Delivery function that owns the end to end delivery picture across our telecommunication network infrastructure programs. We are looking for a technically strong Technical Infrastructure Program Manager to run a portfolio of network builds from planning through completion. You will prioritize work based on customer needs and target dates, make sure deliverables come together across teams, and build integrated delivery plans that carry each build to handover.

You will hold the single, trusted view of delivery status across the program, form a clear position on risk and priority, and recommend decisions to leadership. You will own a portfolio of builds, bring teams to one shared view of status, and drive the prioritization decisions and trade-offs that keep delivery on track. You will give confident, data-backed updates to senior leaders and partner across many teams to move work forward.

You work well in ambiguity. You set up structure, standardize what you can, and improve the process as you go. You communicate clearly in writing and in person, and you hold a portfolio view rather than get pulled into managing every task. - Own portfolio management across the program, prioritizing builds and reporting integrated status to leadership

- Create and maintain performance dashboards and KPIs to measure program effectiveness

Sr. TPM BESS, AWS Global Energy

Job ID: 10552365 | Amazon Data Services, Inc.

Apply now

Description

AWS is deploying battery energy storage systems (BESS) across its global data center fleet. To support this initiative, we are seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager to support the BESS program lead in coordinating delivery across AWS's full BESS portfolio — spanning front-of-the-meter (FTM), behind-the-meter (BTM), and strategic energy partnerships. You will build and run the program mechanisms that keep a complex, multi-org initiative on track: standing up reporting cadences, driving cross-functional alignment, and ensuring senior leadership has clear visibility into capacity delivery, timelines, and decisions needed. This is a high-visibility role with direct exposure to Director and VP level reviews.

Key job responsibilities

• Support the BESS program lead in coordinating end-to-end program delivery across front-of-the-meter (FTM) and behind-the-meter (BTM) BESS work streams consolidating status, dependencies, and critical path items into a single source of truth.

• Establish and run program mechanisms including weekly status updates, monthly business reviews (MBR), and work stream syncs with engineering and cross-functional partners (Procurement, Finance, Legal, Public Policy, FRE, regional energy teams).

• Build automated reporting and KPI dashboards — capacity unlocked (MW), deployment milestones, spend tracking, and key blockers — replacing manual processes with scalable mechanisms.

• Prepare leadership-ready materials including page-zero summaries, capacity-focused drill-downs, and decision documents for VP and S-team reviews.

• Track deployment readiness across BESS programs including integration requirements, utility interconnection, permitting, site planning, OEM qualification status, and commissioning schedules.

• Partner with engineering teams (PGS, DCE) to maintain awareness of technical solutions and translate engineering decisions into program, capacity, and timeline impacts.

A day in the life

Amazon's vision is to be the world's most customer-centric company, and this role is key to that vision as BESS is a strategic priority for AWS. Each day you will interact with teams responsible for battery engineering, power system design, procurement, finance, regional energy management, and data center operations. You prioritize activities to support BESS capacity delivery, solve problems and blockers, and focus on the actions most impactful for program success

About the team

AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS) owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. The Global Energy team within AIS is responsible for securing reliable, cost-effective power for AWS data centers worldwide. We work at the intersection of energy technology, product strategy, and infrastructure planning — evaluating emerging technologies, managing supplier relationships, and ensuring alignment between energy roadmaps and AWS infrastructure requirements. You'll join a diverse team of engineers, energy specialists, and program managers working on some of the most complex energy challenges in the industry.

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science or equivalent

- 5+ years of technical product or program management experience

- 5+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience

- 3+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience

Preferred Qualifications

- 7+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience

- Master's degree or equivalent in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, material science, physics or equivalent

- • Experience in battery energy storage systems (BESS), battery technology, energy storage deployments, data center power architecture, utility interconnection, or grid-scale energy systems

- • Hardware product development experience in data center power infrastructure or adjacent industries (EV, consumer electronics, power systems etc)

- • Experience defining KPIs/SLAs used to drive multi-million dollar programs and managing programs across cross-functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules

- • Excellent written and verbal communication skills — able to distill complex technical programs into concise, actionable narratives for Director and VP audiences

One Material Handling System (OMHS) is building Amazon's in-house material handling capabilities, transforming how Amazon designs, builds, and operates its facilities. We are seeking a talented and motivated Technical Infrastructure Program Manager who will exemplify ownership of their assigned material handling projects, ensuring successful implementation across Amazon's network. Our TIPM works closely with WWDE, Operations Engineering, strategic suppliers, and cross-functional teams to deliver complex material handling systems. In partnership with WWDE, Operations Engineering, strategic suppliers, and other functional groups this individual will drive the execution strategy and management for material handling system implementations. description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

Netflix Games is looking for a Senior Portfolio Operations Manager to build the tools, data solutions, and rhythms that keep our games portfolio clear to the teams who support it. You'll design scalable tools and workflows, use AI to cut manual work and improve reporting, and lead the change management that lets the business adapt quickly.

Netflix Games is building the next generation of games for a worldwide audience. The Games portfolio sits where many teams across Netflix meet: Content, Marketing, Legal, Technology, Discovery, and more. Portfolio Operations Management is the connective tissue that keeps those teams in sync with what's happening across the portfolio.

We don't direct how games are made. We support the layer around them. We run shared portfolio tooling, keep portfolio state visible through reporting and monitoring, set and share the frameworks and standards that cross team boundaries, and help Games Leadership and cross-functional partners turn their needs into working processes.

The ideal candidate lives at the crossroads of program management and data solutions: equally comfortable leading a cross-functional program and designing the data model that powers it. You can effectively translate game production and development for non-production audiences, giving partners in Legal, Marketing, Finance, and Business Development the context they need to act. You'll develop, support, and improve the relational systems our partners rely on as their source of truth, find where AI and automation can remove friction, and deliver solutions that keep teams effortlessly connected. You're comfortable with ambiguity, you build trusting partnerships, and you prefer lightweight, scalable processes over heavy governance.

Responsibilities

Lead, scope, and operationalize cross-functional programs and projects involving multiple stakeholders with limited oversight.

Build and maintain scalable tools and workflows in our relational Airtable database: develop data models, build automations, and design interfaces.

Run regular audits to consolidate or retire redundant fields, tables, views, and automations, keeping systems performant, secure, and easy to navigate.

Use AI tools and agents for operational efficiency, workflow optimization, and intuitive reporting. Find high-leverage opportunities, prototype quickly, and bring proven solutions into production.

Improve portfolio reporting and data monitoring so Games Leadership and partners have accurate, timely visibility to ground and support their decisions.

Translate game production and development concepts (lifecycle phases, gates, milestones, live operations) into clear, actionable context for Games Leadership and non-production partners.

Own data hygiene and accuracy across the tools you support. Monitor health, fix what's broken, and help users serve themselves.

Turn a partner's need into a working process. Know when a tool, automation, playbook, workflow, report, or ritual is the right answer.

Own change management for rollouts, updates, and deprecations: testing, communication, training, adoption, and support - each grounded in a clear what, who, and why with confirmed buy-in.

Bring prioritized, evidence-backed feature requests and user stories to internal tooling and platform product and engineering owners on behalf of the portfolio.

Scope incoming work with discipline. Prioritize work that supports multiple users and that is backed by clear business objectives.

Write durable runbooks, training, and documentation so systems and rhythms outlast any one person.

Requirements

8+ years in operations, program management, business systems, or a related field. Games experience preferred, but not required.

Hands-on experience designing and maintaining relational databases and the workflows built on them. Advanced Airtable experience (schema design, linked records, automations, scripting, interfaces) strongly preferred.

A track record of building scalable internal tools, automations, or reporting that other teams enthusiastically adopt and rely on.

Practical experience using AI tools (LLMs, agents, AI-assisted automation) to improve operations, workflows, or reporting, with good judgment about where AI adds value and where it doesn't.

Strong data skills: modeling, hygiene, and turning raw data into clear, decision-ready reporting. SQL, scripting (JavaScript or Python), or BI tool experience is a plus.

Knowledge of data governance principles, data quality standards, and metadata management.

Proven change management skills, landing rollouts across many stakeholders with measurable adoption.

Ability to translate stakeholder needs into clear requirements and user stories for product and engineering teams.

Clear, proactive communicator who builds lasting partnerships across leadership, production, development, and highly matrixed cross-functional teams.

Comfortable with ambiguity, with a people-over-process mindset and a bias toward lightweight, adoptable solutions.
