Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50.

This Role

France's solution partner ecosystem is an important lever for Dust's growth. As Partner Account Manager, Solution Partners (France), you'll own activation and follow-through for assigned new and existing Tier 1 solution partners that are not yet strategic. You'll turn those relationships into qualified opportunities and repeatable commercial motions, working closely with Dust's Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and Partnerships teams.

This is a hands-on, commercially accountable role. You'll help assigned partners identify the right customer problems, shape clear joint propositions, and move opportunities forward. You'll enable partner teams to explain Dust and support customers effectively, drawing on Dust's technical and delivery teams where needed. Your focus is activation and follow-through for your assigned French solution partner portfolio, in coordination with colleagues who own strategic partner relationships and broader ecosystem programs.

Key Responsibilities

Grow and activate the partner portfolio

  • Own activation and follow-through for assigned new and existing Tier 1 solution partners in France that are not yet strategic, including digital transformation and AI consultancies, systems integrators, and implementation partners

  • Agree on focused joint plans with each priority partner, including target accounts, customer problems, sellable offers, measurable outcomes, owners, and next steps

  • Identify promising new solution partner relationships and qualify them on customer access, strategic fit, delivery capability, and willingness to invest in a joint motion

  • Help partners turn their existing expertise and customer relationships into a clear path to working with Dust

Generate and progress partner-led opportunities

  • Work with partners and Dust Account Executives to identify, qualify, and advance partner-sourced and partner-influenced opportunities

  • Map stakeholders and account entry points, clarify the partner's role, and coordinate next steps across the customer, partner, and Dust teams

  • Support deal strategy, value articulation, and partner participation in sales cycles, escalating product, commercial, or delivery questions to the right teams

  • Maintain a reliable view of partner pipeline, deal progress, risks, and expected contribution in Dust's CRM and reporting processes

Enable partners to sell and support Dust

  • Run practical partner onboarding and enablement so partner teams can explain Dust, identify relevant use cases, and participate confidently in customer conversations

  • Coordinate product, sales, and deployment guidance with Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and Partner Delivery; help partners become increasingly self-sufficient without taking on delivery ownership

  • Share relevant customer stories, use cases, and sales materials, and identify gaps in the enablement partners need to move opportunities forward

  • Help partners understand how Dust connects to customer systems and supports teams using multiple AI models and agents

Build a repeatable solution partner motion

  • Establish a consistent operating rhythm with partners, including pipeline reviews, business reviews, action tracking, and timely escalation of blockers

  • Monitor partner activation, qualified pipeline, opportunity progression, closed revenue, and partner readiness; use the evidence to focus time and investment

  • Identify patterns in successful partner-led deals and feed practical recommendations into the broader Partnerships and GTM teams

  • Surface customer and partner feedback from the French market to inform positioning, offers, enablement, and go-to-market priorities

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in partnerships, channel sales, business development, or commercial account management in B2B SaaS or a related technology business

  • A track record of creating measurable commercial outcomes through partners, such as qualified pipeline, co-sell opportunities, partner activation, or revenue

  • Strong understanding of the French B2B partner ecosystem, including consultancies, systems integrators, and implementation partners, with the ability to qualify them on customer access and fit

  • Fluent French and professional English, with the ability to lead partner and customer conversations in both languages

  • Commercial judgment and operating discipline: you can prioritize a partner portfolio, build actionable joint plans, manage a pipeline, and maintain clear follow-through

  • Confidence coordinating multi-party sales opportunities and aligning external partners with internal sales and technical teams

  • Strong communication and enablement skills: you can make a technical product understandable and help others present its value credibly

  • A self-starter who is comfortable with ambiguity, takes ownership, raises risks early, and builds practical processes as the motion develops

At Apaleo, we're building the open, API-first property management platform for hospitality. With integrations across hundreds of apps through the Apaleo Store, and the first AI agent marketplace for hospitality in our Agent Hub, we simplify operations, elevate the guest journey and drive revenue growth for our customers.

You'll turn our AI capabilities into coherent, commercially viable products that solve real operational problems for hoteliers. Your goal is to help hotels move towards genuinely autonomous operations, not to ship isolated automations or AI assistants. 

This is not a backlog role. You'll take an ambiguous opportunity, find the right customer problems, define the proposition, build it with Engineering, bring it to market and drive adoption. You'll also play a central role in turning our AI capabilities into a meaningful and growing source of revenue. 

This is a senior individual contributor role with real autonomy. You won't receive a roadmap and execute it. You'll shape it along our vision, using customer insight, data and sound reasoning. You'll work closely with Engineering, Design, Sales, Marketing and Customer Success, and in close collaboration with our other value stream teams.  

 

What you'll be up to 

  • Productising and commercialising our AI capabilities. Define the proposition, target customers and use cases, and shape packaging and launch with commercial teams.

  • Productising hospitality knowledge. Turn hospitality expertise and operational processes into scalable product experiences, with appropriate human oversight.

  • Driving adoption. Run discovery, shape onboarding and usability, measure adoption and improve from real-world feedback. 
  • Keeping AI products reliable and viable. Define good agent performance, understand cost and latency, set up evaluation and monitoring with Engineering, and trade off autonomy, reliability, human intervention and cost. 
  • Owning strategy, roadmap and delivery in your scope, with clear specs, a definition of done and impact analysis. 
  • Working with Engineering on trade-offs, dependencies, quality and our API-first AI-first architecture. 
  • Balancing ambition with reality. Weigh the roadmap against operational requests, bugs and technical debt, and say no to good ideas that aren't great ones. 
  • Spotting dependencies early with Hotel Operations and other engineering teams, since our AI capabilities build on the core platform. 
  • Using AI in your own PM work and championing AI-assisted engineering.  

 

What you'll bring 

  • 6+ years as a Product Manager, owning products from discovery through launch and adoption with limited day-to-day direction. 
  • Proven zero-to-one experience. You've taken a new B2B product, not a feature, from an ambiguous problem to paying customers, driving discovery, validation, definition, prioritisation and launch. 
  • Ownership after launch. You've owned a revenue, adoption or retention number and can tell us what moved and what you killed, pivoted or repriced. 
  • Commercial thinking. You've defined propositions, packaging and pricing, validated willingness to pay and worked with Sales, Marketing and Customer Success on go-to-market. 
  • Systems and process thinking. You break processes into steps, decisions and handoffs, and understand how systems with different data models and sources of truth affect the reliability of agents. 
  • Meaningful AI product experience. You've built and launched AI-powered products or capabilities used by real customers, understand what makes a product agentic, and can discuss context, tools, latency, cost and evaluation, with a view on human-in-the-loop design. 
  • Customer centricity and product judgement. You turn interview patterns into opportunities, make tough trade-offs and prioritise ruthlessly. 
  • Platform thinking. You weigh customer needs against reusable capabilities, API consistency and long-term platform evolution. 
  • Stakeholder alignment. You align Engineering, commercial teams and peers, manage cross-team dependencies and communicate trade-offs with confidence. 
  • Autonomy and adaptability. You take ownership, raise risks early and make progress through ambiguity. 

 

Strongly preferred 

  • Agentic AI products in production. You've taken an agentic AI product beyond prototype to paying customers, and dealt with reliability, permissions, exceptions, human intervention and evaluation. This is different from AI-powered features such as chatbots, summarisation or copilots. 

 

Nice to have 

  • Hospitality technology or hotel operations experience. 
  • Experience with PMS, RMS, CRS, channel managers, OTAs or hospitality distribution. 
  • Experience in B2B SaaS platforms, ecosystems or integration-heavy products. 
  • Experience with AI governance, permissions, identity, orchestration or enterprise AI adoption. 
  • Experience in a fast-moving startup or scale-up. 
  • Comfort with AI-assisted engineering processes. 

 

Don't tick every box? Hospitality experience is an advantage, not a prerequisite. A strong zero-to-one B2B product builder from another domain, with real AI product experience and a commercial mindset, can be a better fit than a hospitality specialist without them. We'd still love to hear from you. 

 

Who you are 

  • You take high ownership. You answer for product outcomes, not just delivery commitments. 
  • You're strategic and hands-on. You can set a product vision and still get into customer discovery, operational processes and detailed product decisions. 
  • You're comfortable with ambiguity. You make progress when the problem or the solution isn't fully defined.

How you make an impact joining Apaleo: Joining Apaleo is more than taking on a role. It's about driving real change in the hospitality industry. Your contributions will directly shape our innovative platform, influence company-wide decisions and help redefine the future of hospitality tech.

title: Senior AI Product Manager (f/m/d)
description:
OUR PURPOSE AT PLANCRAFT

Building the backbone of European trades together – with AI-first software.
We’re not just building software – we’re on a mission to create space for contractors & tradespeople by equipping them with AI solutions that work the way they do: fast, practical, and AI-first. With Tier 1 Investors from Europe and the US, like Headline and Creandum as well as 30,000+ tradespeople as customer base, we’re scaling across Europe to turn scattered tradespeople into thriving communities. We believe in zero admin, not zero personality – and we build every feature with the people in mind who wear the boots, not the suits. We’re #stoked to shape the future, #together as a team, and #humble in our mission to support the builders of tomorrow.

YOUR MISSION AT PLANCRAFT

As a Senior AI Product Manager, you move plancraft closer to becoming the autopilot for the trades: Evolving our product from software that helps tradespeople manage their work into one where AI agents can take on meaningful parts of their daily workload.

This is not about adding AI features to an existing roadmap. You’ll own an emerging problem space and identify where agents can create the highest leverage for our customers beyond what Plancraft does today. That means getting close to tradespeople and their businesses, uncovering the problems worth solving, and working with Engineering and UX to turn them into reliable, trustworthy products customers are willing to rely on for real work.

You’ll operate across the full product journey: from spending time with tradespeople in the field and deciding which opportunity to pursue, to working with Engineering to understand technical requirements and trade-offs, defining evaluation criteria, shipping to production, and learning from real-world usage.

The impact should be tangible. The products you build will aim to help trades businesses improve outcomes such as profit margins, quote acceptance rates, and capacity utilisation — while opening up entirely new product and growth opportunities for plancraft.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own the product strategy, roadmap, and delivery for Plancraft’s customer-facing AI agents and workflows.

  • Identify high-potential customer problems beyond today’s platform and translate messy, real-world trades workflows into focused opportunities for agentic products.

  • Define and own the single co-worker interface for customers to interact with and manage agents and their underlying workflows.

  • Work in a Product Trio with Engineering and UX throughout discovery, evaluation, and delivery, from early problem validation to production-quality releases.

  • Establish a repeatable AI product operating loop across discovery, evaluation, release gates, monitoring, and iteration.

  • Define and maintain evaluation sets, quality standards, and release criteria for customer-facing AI products, including accuracy, correction rates, latency, and safe rollback conditions.

  • Instrument and monitor AI product performance, using customer behaviour and quality signals to decide what to scale, change, or stop.

  • Demonstrate measurable customer outcomes from AI-powered workflows, including improvements in efficiency, profitability, quote acceptance, capacity utilisation, activation, and retention.

  • Contribute the Product perspective to technical and platform trade-offs, including customer value, quality, cost, and time to market, together with Engineering and the shared AI infrastructure counterpart.

  • Partner across Product and Engineering to manage dependencies, reusable AI experience patterns, mobile and voice input, and handovers between customer workflows.

  • Work closely with RevOps, Sales, and Customer Success to understand adoption and willingness-to-pay signals and contribute to AI pricing and monetisation experiments.

Must-Have Skills

  • 7+ years of product management experience, including at least 2 years owning and shipping AI products in production end-to-end.

  • Strong applied GenAI literacy across LLMs, agents, RAG, and evaluation frameworks — sufficient to understand technical requirements and help evaluate Product, quality, cost, and time-to-market trade-offs together with Engineering.

  • Experience building 0-to-1 AI products or new product areas, from customer discovery and problem definition through production launch and iteration.

  • Experience defining quality and success criteria for AI products, including evaluation metrics, release thresholds, customer outcomes, and post-launch monitoring.

  • Strong customer discovery and product judgment, with the ability to turn complex real-world workflows into focused AI product opportunities.

  • Experience in a fast-moving startup or scale-up environment, with a track record of creating structure, setting priorities, and delivering despite ambiguity.

  • Proven cross-functional ownership, working closely with Engineering and UX from discovery through production and managing dependencies across teams.

  • English at C1 level and German at C2 level.

  • Willingness to stay close to customers and the team, including field discovery with tradespeople and regular presence in Hamburg (approximately one week per month or equivalent).

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with voice, mobile, or document AI, particularly products that turn unstructured inputs into reliable workflows.

  • Experience with AI monetisation, including usage-based, credit-based, or hybrid pricing models.

  • Background in B2B SaaS for SMBs, field service, construction, or the trades.

  • Familiarity with product and research tools such as PostHog, Sentry, Dovetail, or ProductFruits.

  • Additional language skills in Italian, Spanish, Dutch, or Polish.

WHO THIS ROLE IS FOR

You’ll probably enjoy this role if you want to build rather than inherit.

You like starting with an important but not fully defined problem and creating clarity through customer insight, data, experimentation, and strong product judgment. You’re excited by AI because of the problems it can solve — not simply because the technology is new.

You’re comfortable working closely with engineers, understanding technical requirements and evaluation results, and translating them into sound Product decisions.

You want meaningful ownership. You’re comfortable making decisions with incomplete information, narrowing a large opportunity space into the right first wedge, shipping it, learning from real usage, and changing course when the evidence tells you to.

And importantly, you want your work to have a visible outcome. The products you build here should change how trades businesses operate — and their adoption, customer value, and commercial impact will be measurable.

WHY PLANCRAFT?

  • Team Spirit: We’re driven by passion, commitment, and a shared mission. Team spirit matters to us — and we make it visible: with four major team event weeks per year, casual monthly on-site and remote formats, and a strong recognition culture where we regularly celebrate both the big and small wins together.

  • Ownership: You’re encouraged to take ownership from day one. In a flat hierarchy and high-trust environment, you’re empowered to make meaningful decisions and drive real impact.

  • Learning & Growth: We invest in your personal and professional development through a strong feedback culture with 6-monthly 360° growth reviews, a personal learning budget (1.500€/year), 2 paid days of educational leave, and targeted enablement formats. Our goal is to help you unlock your full potential.

  • AI Enablement: Our internal tools and workflows are AI-enabled by design. We support every team and individual in applying AI at the next level in their daily work.

  • Tech & Tooling: You’ll receive a MacBook, premium headphones, and everything else you need — from hardware to tools — to be effective in your daily doing.

  • Flexibility: Whether remote, hybrid, abroad or on-site — you work where you’re at your best. Our Hamburg office (with a rooftop terrace) is always open, and you decide each week how often you come in. And if you need a change of scenery, working abroad worldwide up to 2 months is always an option.

  • Recharge: To ensure the needed rest, we offer 30 vacation days per year (based on a 5-day week) plus Dec 24th off. We also subsidize your Urban Sports Club membership and organize internal sport meetups.

  • Mobility: You can lease a "JobRad" (Bike) and get a subsidized "Deutschlandticket" or "BahnCard" for public transport to be supported in your commute.

  • International Environment: We’re becoming more international every month, with team members already in Italy, Spain, the Netherlands, and Austria — which is why English is our internal company language.

We’re #stoked to shape the future, #together as a team, and #humble in our mission to support the builders of tomorrow. For a first impression of us, take a look at our Instagram and LinkedIn page.

Diversity makes us better.
We welcome people of all backgrounds, identities, abilities, and experiences, and we believe that different perspectives lead to better ideas, stronger products, and a healthier workplace. If you’re excited about our mission but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be exactly who we’re looking for.

______

On the application process
We want your candidate experience with us to be smooth, transparent, and enjoyable. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process typically takes about 4 weeks from start to finish, though this may vary by role. You can learn more about our process here. If you need adjustments or flexibility at any stage, please don’t hesitate to let us know — we’ll do our best to make it work for you.

Note on creating a test account:
If you would like to create a test account as part of the challenge, please enter "Applicant" in the relevant field during registration and select "Other" under Trade. This ensures that our sales team does not mistakenly register you as a craft business and reach out to you unnecessarily.

Ready to work somewhere that cares more about how you build software than how fast you can ship it?

At Opencast, we don’t measure developers by the number of tickets you complete. We care about engineering craft, clean design and thoughtful problem-solving. 
 
Opencast consultants deliver in complex environments, pairing often and working with others who take pride in doing things properly: TDD, emerging design, refactoring and leaving code better than they found it.
 
We build software we are proud of, and our clients trust us not just to code but to think, challenge and guide.
 
If you value simple and robust solutions and want a role where your judgment matters as much as your keyboard, this could be a great fit for you.

The role

Software developers at Opencast care about building products right and combine their own experience and approach with our company values. They are tech agnostic, have expertise in agile methodologies, eXtreme programming practices and use industry-leading programming languages to deliver agile transformation.
 
Our approach to software development is collaborative, focused on keeping things simple, and we use test driven development and pair programming as best practice.
 
Working with clients and key stakeholders is a crucial part of a consultancy role. Our developers are inclusive team players that listen, collaborate, can positively challenge and manage expectations when needed but most of all are always willing to teach and help others. Leaving a client with improved ways of working, working technology and a good experience from discovery through to live is the priority. 
 
The role is varied, technical, never confined to any one provider or solution and there are always opportunities for learning and development.
 

Requirements

This role involves weekly on-site work, and you’ll be required to travel regularly to client locations across the UK. We’re looking for people who value in-person collaboration, enjoy building strong relationships, and are passionate about delivering solutions that make a real difference for our clients.
 
Due to the nature of this role, you must either hold active Security Check (SC) clearance or be eligible and willing to undergo the clearance process. 
 
SC clearance is granted in line with UK Government security vetting requirements. Typically, applicants must have UK citizenship and have lived continuously in the UK for at least the past five years, with no single absence exceeding 28 consecutive days. Nationality and immigration status may also be considered as part of the vetting process. We are unable to progress applications from candidates who do not meet these requirements.
 
If you are unsure whether you meet the eligibility criteria, we encourage you to review the guidance or discuss this with us before applying.
 
We are recruiting for multiple positions, with opportunities available immediately and in the coming months. If you are interested in joining Opencast, we encourage you to apply. 
 

Essential experience

To succeed in this role, you’ll have experience as a Senior Software Developer and be able to demonstrate, with tangible examples, that you can:
 
  • Lead the design and delivery of high-quality, user-centred services using Java or Scala.
  • Use a range of technologies, including languages such as Kotlin, Ruby or JavaScript, to solve real problems in the right way.
  • Design and build scalable, maintainable systems, considering performance, security and accessibility.
  • Build quality into your work by embedding strong testing practices throughout delivery.
  • Deliver complex digital services, supporting others to do the same.
  • Explore and adopt new technologies, helping teams learn and continuously improve.
  • Work within agile teams to deliver value early and often, adapting to changing needs.
 

Essential consulting skills

In addition to software engineering skills, there are essential core skills you’ll need to be an Opencast consultant. You’ll need to demonstrate how you:

 

  • Shape and guide delivery by driving clear, prioritised backlogs aligned to user and client needs.
  • Lead on technical delivery, supporting others and ensuring a high-quality approach from idea through to implementation.
  • Set and evolve testing approaches that build confidence and improve outcomes across the team.
  • Encourage collaborative ways of working, including pairing and mobbing, to share knowledge and strengthen delivery.
  • Build trusted relationships with clients and stakeholders, communicating openly and helping shape the right solutions.
  • Lead technical conversations in discovery and delivery, bringing clarity to complex problems.
  • Support and develop others through coaching, mentoring and sharing good practice.
  • Respond positively to change, showing resilience, adaptability and a commitment to continuous improvement.
  • Bring multidisciplinary teams together, aligning stakeholders and disciplines to shape solutions and deliver value for users.
 
During the interview process, we’ll ask questions to explore your experience across these areas.

 

Salary

£61,001 - £78,000 per annum.
 

What we offer


A competitive package including a 7% employer pension contribution, share options, and a discretionary bonus. You’ll also benefit from 25 days’ holiday and access to 3 annual “life happens” days to support unexpected situations.  We provide wellbeing support, ongoing professional development, volunteering opportunities, and the chance to be part of a genuinely supportive team.
 

Where you’ll work


This role requires regular on-site attendance at our HQ, hub offices, and client sites, as well as the ability to work from home. Applicants must be able to travel to offices and client sites across the UK as part of their normal working arrangements, as travel is essential for fulfilling the responsibilities of the role.
 

We include you

 
We welcome candidates from all identities, attributes, ways of thinking and backgrounds to thrive in a career at Opencast. Our aim is for the diversity of our people to be reflected in the solutions we deliver, to help create a fairer society for all.
 

Interview


Interviews will be conducted via Microsoft Teams. We’re happy to make adjustments to support your needs.

description:
We’re on a mission to protect society from fraud and money laundering. We’ve already protected over 3 million people through life’s big transactions.

Fraud and regulation are rising, costing the UK economy over £100bn every year; this makes it more difficult for businesses to protect themselves and their clients - individuals like you and me - from fraud and money laundering.

Our co-founders Olly and Jack were led to this area when a friend was defrauded of £25K when buying their first property. At the time, anti-fraud technology didn’t exist, which meant that completing the anti-fraud checks required in these processes was largely manual. These big life moments should be exciting, but instead are often confusing and scary due to the painful process of completing these paper-based checks and the risk of fraud.

Thirdfort helps businesses to facilitate these anti fraud checks so that individuals know they can transact safely and seamlessly with professionals during these big transactions. Our anti-fraud platform provides a secure way for professionals in regulated sectors like Lawyers, Estate Agents and Accountants to transfer funds and verify sensitive information through app based document checks, facial recognition and open banking.

Over 1,500 businesses now trust Thirdfort to verify their clients. We are FCA regulated and have raised over \$33m in capital from leading Fintech investors Breega and Element Ventures, as well as the founders of Zoopla, Funding Circle, Comply Advantage, Tessian, Fenergo and Fidel.
